克隆工序需要大量资源。尤其在自然繁殖可能产生更多基因多样性的情况下，我们是否更应该将这些资源花费在更其他地方？

texts.en:
Our collective consciousness is in turmoil. We now possess the ability to create copies of ourselves, yet we hesitate, questioning the efficacy (and even the morality) of such actions.

Cloning processes require significant resources. Might these be better spent elsewhere, particularly as natural procreation is likely to produce more genetic diversity?

Historically, this has not been our method of procreation, and we are uncertain if we are ready to embrace such a fundamental change to our species.

label.zh: 克隆的高效性难以忽视。
label.en: The efficiency of cloning cannot be ignored.
